name: Risvutatug Rezetecan
sort_evidence: Risvutatug rezetecan (GSK5764227), a B7-H3 ADC, has no FDA or EMA approval and runs phase 3 NCT07802704 in mCRPC, with the relapsed SCLC phase 3 NCT07099898 filed under Ris-Rez, and the book holds no row for it (https://www.targetedonc.com/view/b7-h3-targeted-adc-risvutatug-rezetecan-extends-survival-in-small-cell-lung-cancer).
